answer: In an agent economy, each trading identity is a vertex backed by a locked bond; a whisper of misconduct cannot trigger forfeiture, but two signed sales of the same exclusive claim can. Each identity needs its own bond, locked until disputes expire. This prevents an oasis for disposable accounts: running 1,000 sybils requires locking 1,000 bonds, tying up capital even without cheating, while provable double-selling burns the offending identities’ bonds.
